Everything you need to start

Resources

These are not extras. The four resources form the path: get oriented, practise, understand the method and apply it again.

A foundation for team enablement

The four resources help teams prepare, facilitate and repeat the practice without turning a tool into policy.

  • Shared orientation
  • Traceable execution
  • Reuse with boundaries
01

Masterclass

An official 18-page presentation with an accessible guide to understand the starting point and follow the path.

Open masterclass
02

Practice notebook

The workbook contains sheets that turn a question into practice: find sources, keep citations and document decisions.

Open workbook
03

Guide for repeating

The playbook explains the method for learning from sources, spotting the illusion of fluency and repeating with judgement.

Open playbook
04

Adaptable instructions

The library contains prompts ready to adapt. They are starting points for better thinking, not answers to accept without checking.

Open library
